use default

is_perfect(n: int) -> bool is
    if n < 2 then
        return false
    fi

    let divisors =
        (1::n / 2)
            |> filter(d => n % d == 0)
            |> reduce(0, (running, d) => running + d)

    return divisors == n
si

write_line((1::10000) |> filter(is_perfect) |> join(", "))
